premise: Little Fish can't understand why the rubber ring sits on top of the water when pebbles and shells sink; he pushes it down, it pops back up, and Turtle tells him it's full of air.
inspiration: The 'why' questions of the Just So stories, answered truly and in play: the secret is air.
lesson: Asking why is how you find out.
learning: A rubber ring floats because it is full of air.

en-US.title: Why the Ring Floats
en-US.text: {ring:enter} {ring:go to sea} The rubber ring was bobbing on the sea, red and white and round. {ring:pulse} {fish:enter} {fish:go to ring} Little Fish swam up underneath it. [curious] How does it sit on top of the water like that? he wondered. Pebbles sink. Shells sink. {fish:face surprised} So he pushed it down with his nose. {ring:wobble} Down it went… and {sfx:bloop} BLOOP! Up it popped again. {ring:hop} [laughs] {fish:face happy} {fish:live laugh} {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to shore} Turtle crawled down to the water's edge to see. [warmly] It's full of air inside, said Turtle. And air always wants to go up, so the ring floats. {fish:face surprised} Like a balloon in the water? said Little Fish. {turtle:face happy} {turtle:live nod} Exactly. {ring:live spin} The ring turned slowly round, as if it was nodding. {turtle:live peek} Turtle tucked her head in, and peeked out again, smiling. {fish:live wiggle} And Little Fish wiggled his fins and swam round and round the ring, because now he knew its secret. {fish:hearts}

es-ES.title: Por qué flota el flotador
es-ES.text: {ring:enter} {ring:go to sea} El flotador se mecía sobre el mar, rojo, blanco y redondo. {ring:pulse} {fish:enter} {fish:go to ring} Pececito nadó hasta ponerse debajo. [curious] ¿Cómo puede quedarse ahí encima del agua?, se preguntó. Las piedras se hunden. Las conchas se hunden. {fish:face surprised} Así que lo empujó hacia abajo con el hocico. {ring:wobble} Abajo se fue… y {sfx:bloop} ¡BLUP! Volvió a subir. {ring:hop} [laughs] {fish:face happy} {fish:live laugh} {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to shore} Tortuga bajó arrastrándose hasta la orilla para verlo. [warmly] Está lleno de aire, dijo Tortuga. Y el aire siempre quiere subir, por eso el flotador flota. {fish:face surprised} ¿Como un globo en el agua?, dijo Pececito. {turtle:face happy} {turtle:live nod} Exacto. {ring:live spin} El flotador giró despacito, como si dijera que sí. {turtle:live peek} Tortuga escondió la cabeza y volvió a asomarla, sonriendo. {fish:live wiggle} Y Pececito meneó las aletas y nadó alrededor del flotador una y otra vez, porque ya conocía su secreto. {fish:hearts}

ja-JP.title: うきわは なぜ うくの？
ja-JP.text: {ring:enter}{ring:go to sea}うきわが、海の上で、ぷかぷか。赤と白の、まあるいうきわです。{ring:pulse}{fish:enter}{fish:go to ring}おさかなくんが、そのしたに、およいできました。[curious]どうして、水の上に、のっかっていられるのかな？小石は、しずむ。かいがらも、しずむ。{fish:face surprised}そこで、はなさきで、ぐいっとおしてみました。{ring:wobble}しずんで…{sfx:bloop}ぽこんっ！また、うかんできました。{ring:hop}[laughs]{fish:face happy}{fish:live laugh}おさかなくんは、くすくす。{turtle:enter}{turtle:go to shore}ウミガメさんが、波打ち際まで、見にきました。[warmly]「なかに、くうきが、いっぱいつまっているのよ」 とウミガメさん。「くうきは、いつも上へいきたがるの。だから、うきわは、うくのよ」 {fish:face surprised}「水のなかの、ふうせんみたいに？」 とおさかなくん。{turtle:face happy}{turtle:live nod}「そのとおり」 {ring:live spin}うきわが、ゆっくりまわりました。まるで、うんうん、とうなずいているみたい。{turtle:live peek}ウミガメさんは、くびをひっこめて、また、にっこりかおを出しました。{fish:live wiggle}おさかなくんは、ひれをぴちぴち。うきわのまわりを、ぐるぐるおよぎました。だって、もう、うきわのひみつを、しっているんだもの。{fish:hearts}

de-DE.title: Warum der Ring nicht untergeht
de-DE.text: {ring:enter} {ring:go to sea} Der Schwimmring schaukelte auf dem Meer, rot und weiß und rund. {ring:pulse} {fish:enter} {fish:go to ring} Das Fischchen schwamm unter ihn. [curious] „Wie kann der bloß so oben auf dem Wasser sitzen?“, fragte es sich. Steinchen gehen unter. Schneckenhäuser gehen unter. {fish:face surprised} Also drückte es ihn mit der Nase hinunter. {ring:wobble} Runter ging er… und {sfx:bloop} BLUBB! Schon ploppte er wieder hoch. {ring:hop} [laughs] {fish:face happy} {fish:live laugh} {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to shore} Die Meeresschildkröte kroch ans Ufer, um zu schauen. [warmly] „Er ist innen voller Luft“, sagte die Schildkröte. „Und Luft will immer nach oben, darum bleibt der Ring oben.“ {fish:face surprised} „Wie ein Luftballon im Wasser?“, fragte das Fischchen. {turtle:face happy} {turtle:live nod} „Genau.“ {ring:live spin} Der Ring drehte sich langsam, als würde er nicken. {turtle:live peek} Die Schildkröte zog den Kopf ein und lugte lächelnd wieder heraus. {fish:live wiggle} Und das Fischchen zappelte mit den Flossen und schwamm rund um den Ring, immer rundherum, denn jetzt kannte es sein Geheimnis. {fish:hearts}

fr-FR.title: Pourquoi la bouée flotte
fr-FR.text: {ring:enter} {ring:go to sea} La bouée se balançait sur la mer, rouge et blanche, toute ronde. {ring:pulse} {fish:enter} {fish:go to ring} Petit Poisson est venu nager juste en dessous. [curious] « Comment fait-elle pour rester sur l’eau comme ça ? » se demandait-il. Les cailloux, ça coule. Les coquillages, ça coule. {fish:face surprised} Alors il l’a poussée vers le fond avec son nez. {ring:wobble} Elle est descendue… et {sfx:bloop} BLOUP ! Elle est remontée d’un coup. {ring:hop} [laughs] {fish:face happy} {fish:live laugh} {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to shore} Tortue de mer est descendue jusqu’au bord de l’eau pour voir. [warmly] « Elle est pleine d’air, a dit Tortue. Et l’air veut toujours monter, alors la bouée flotte. » {fish:face surprised} « Comme un ballon dans l’eau ? » a dit Petit Poisson. {turtle:face happy} {turtle:live nod} « Exactement. » {ring:live spin} La bouée a tourné doucement, comme si elle disait oui. {turtle:live peek} Tortue a rentré la tête, puis elle l’a ressortie en souriant. {fish:live wiggle} Et Petit Poisson a frétillé des nageoires, et il a nagé autour de la bouée, encore et encore, car maintenant, il connaissait son secret. {fish:hearts}

it-IT.title: Perché il salvagente galleggia
it-IT.text: {ring:enter} {ring:go to sea} Il salvagente dondolava sul mare, bianco e rosso e tondo. {ring:pulse} {fish:enter} {fish:go to ring} Pesciolino è arrivato nuotando proprio lì sotto. [curious] «Come fa a stare lì sopra l'acqua?», si è chiesto. I sassi vanno a fondo. Le conchiglie vanno a fondo. {fish:face surprised} Allora l'ha spinto giù col muso. {ring:wobble} Giù, giù… e {sfx:bloop} BLUB! È rispuntato fuori. {ring:hop} [laughs] {fish:face happy} {fish:live laugh} {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to shore} Tartaruga marina è scesa strisciando fino alla riva, per vedere. [warmly] «Dentro è pieno d'aria», ha detto Tartaruga. «E l'aria vuole sempre andare in su: per questo il salvagente galleggia.» {fish:face surprised} «Come un palloncino nell'acqua?», ha detto Pesciolino. {turtle:face happy} {turtle:live nod} «Proprio così.» {ring:live spin} Il salvagente ha girato piano piano, come se dicesse di sì. {turtle:live peek} Tartaruga ha ritirato la testa, e poi ha fatto di nuovo capolino, sorridendo. {fish:live wiggle} E Pesciolino ha agitato le pinne e ha nuotato intorno al salvagente, in tondo in tondo, perché adesso conosceva il suo segreto. {fish:hearts}

zh-TW.title: 游泳圈為什麼會浮
zh-TW.text: {ring:enter}{ring:go to sea}游泳圈在海上漂呀漂，紅紅白白的，圓圓的。{ring:pulse}{fish:enter}{fish:go to ring}小魚游到它的下面。[curious]「它怎麼能那樣坐在水上面呢？」 小魚想。小石頭會沉下去。貝殼也會沉下去。{fish:face surprised}於是，牠用頭把游泳圈往下頂。{ring:wobble}游泳圈沉下去了……然後，{sfx:bloop}啵！它又彈了上來。{ring:hop}[laughs]{fish:face happy}{fish:live laugh}{turtle:enter}{turtle:go to shore}海龜慢慢爬到岸邊來看。[warmly]「它裡面裝滿了空氣，」 海龜說，「空氣總是想往上跑，所以游泳圈會浮起來。」 {fish:face surprised}「就像水裡的氣球？」 小魚說。{turtle:face happy}{turtle:live nod}「沒錯。」 {ring:live spin}游泳圈慢慢轉了一圈，好像也在點頭。{turtle:live peek}海龜把頭縮進去，又探出來，笑咪咪的。{fish:live wiggle}小魚搖搖鰭，繞著游泳圈游了一圈又一圈，因為牠現在知道它的祕密了。{fish:hearts}

zh-HK.title: 水泡為甚麼會浮
zh-HK.text: {ring:enter}{ring:go to sea}水泡在海面上一浮一浮的，紅白色的，圓圓的。{ring:pulse}{fish:enter}{fish:go to ring}小魚游到它下面。[curious]「佢點解可以噉樣坐喺水上面嘅呢？」 牠想。小石頭會沉到水底。貝殼也會沉。{fish:face surprised}於是，牠用鼻子把水泡按下去。{ring:wobble}水泡沉了下去……然後{sfx:bloop}啵！它又彈了上來。{ring:hop}[laughs]{fish:face happy}{fish:live laugh}{turtle:enter}{turtle:go to shore}海龜慢慢爬到水邊來看看。[warmly]「佢入面裝滿咗空氣㗎，」 海龜說，「空氣成日都想向上走，所以水泡會浮。」 {fish:face surprised}「好似水入面嘅氣球噉？」 小魚問。{turtle:face happy}{turtle:live nod}「冇錯，就係噉！」 {ring:live spin}水泡慢慢轉了一圈，好像在點頭。{turtle:live peek}海龜把頭縮進去，又笑着探出來。{fish:live wiggle}小魚擺擺魚鰭，繞着水泡游了一圈又一圈，因為現在，牠知道水泡的秘密了。{fish:hearts}

bloop.prompt: a rubber ring popping up out of the water with a playful bloop and a small splash
